description: Java source code for ContentFragment class in an Android app, managing UI interactions, drag-and-drop, image sharing, and action modes within a gallery app.

classes.name: ContentFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays content, handles drag-and-drop, UI toggling, image sharing, and contextual action modes.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Initializes UI, sets drag and click listeners, manages UI visibility toggling and action mode activation.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Performs setup after activity creation, restores state, and updates UI based on saved instance state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, such as navigating up.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves UI state and current content position.

methods.name: setSystemUiVisible
methods.description: Toggles system UI and action bar visibility.

methods.name: processDragStarted
methods.description: Checks if drag event contains plain text mime type.

methods.name: processDrop
methods.description: Handles drop event, parses data, updates content, and selection.

methods.name: updateContentAndRecycleBitmap
methods.description: Updates displayed image and recycles previous bitmap.

methods.name: shareCurrentPhoto
methods.description: Compresses and shares the current photo asynchronously.

methods.name: mContentSelectionActionModeCallback
methods.description: Handles contextual action mode for photo selection, including sharing.
